channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV oo soo gabagabeeyay safar 12 maalmood ah oo uu ku tagay Koonfurta Ameerika
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha Kaniisadda Kaatooligga Pope Leo XIV ayaa Isniinta soo afjaray safar 12 maalmood ah oo uu ku maray Uruguay, Argentina iyo Peru, isagoo dib u xaqiijiyay mowqifkiisa caddaaladda bulshada iyo ilaalinta deegaanka.

item.title: Joojintii duulimaadyada Mareykanka: Buttigieg oo ka jawaabay eedda Trump, shirkadaha diyaaradaha oo khasaare wajahaya
item.description: Wasiirkii hore ee Gaadiidka Mareykanka Pete Buttigieg ayaa Isniinta diiday sheegashada Madaxweyne Donald Trump ee ah in isaga lagu eedeeyo joojintii guud ee duulimaadyada ka dhacday dalka Jimcihii.

item.title: Mareykanka oo 6-2 ku garaacay Kanada, ku guuleystay horyaalka adduunka ee hockey-ga barafka dumarka
item.description: Xulka dumarka Mareykanka ayaa Isniinta 6-2 kaga adkaaday Kanada ciyaartii kama dambeysta ahayd ee horyaalka adduunka ee hockey-ga barafka, oo lagu qabtay Herning ee dalka Denmark.

item.title: Philip Rivers oo si rasmi ah loogu soo bandhigay tababaraha cusub ee NC State
item.description: Ciyaaryahankii hore ee NFL Philip Rivers ayaa Isniinta magaalada Raleigh si rasmi ah loogu soo bandhigay tababaraha cusub ee kooxda kubadda cagta Mareykanka ee jaamacadda NC State, oo uu hore ugu soo ciyaaray.

item.title: Alexander Zverev oo Turin lagu guddoonsiiyay koobka ciyaaryahanka lambarka 1 ee adduunka sannadkan
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka tennis-ka Jarmalka Alexander Zverev ayaa Isniinta magaalada Turin lagu guddoonsiiyay koobka ciyaaryahanka ku dhammeystay sannadka 2026 isagoo ah lambarka 1 ee adduunka.

item.title: Madaxweyne Deni iyo safiirka Ingiriiska oo Garoowe kaga wada hadlay amniga iyo siyaasadda Soomaaliya
item.description: Madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa Isniinta magaalada Garoowe kulan kula qaatay safiirka Boqortooyada Ingiriiska u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Charles King, iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayay.

item.title: Kumanaan macmiil oo bangiyada waaweyn ee Mareykanka aan u gali karin xisaabaadkooda onlaynka
item.description: Macaamiil badan oo ka tirsan bangiyada ugu waaweyn Mareykanka, oo uu ugu horreeyo Chase, ayaa Isniinta sheegay inay awoodi waayeen inay galaan xisaabaadkooda onlaynka ah ama lacag wareejiyaan.

item.title: Lazio oo war cusub ka bixisay dhaawacyada Frattesi, Zaccagni iyo Tavares kahor ciyaarta Lecce
item.description: Kooxda Lazio ee horyaalka Serie A ayaa Isniinta soo saartay warbixin caafimaad oo rasmi ah oo ku saabsan xaaladda saddex ciyaaryahan oo dhaawacan, Davide Frattesi, Mattia Zaccagni iyo Nuno Tavares.

item.title: UEFA oo si wadajir ah u taageertay Philippe Diallo si uu ugu tartamo Infantino doorashada madaxweynaha FIFA
item.description: Ururka kubadda cagta Yurub ee UEFA ayaa Isniinta bayaan ku sheegay inuu si wadajir ah u taageeray madaxweynaha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Faransiiska Philippe Diallo, si uu ula tartamo Gianni Infantino doorashada madaxweynaha FIFA ee bisha March.

item.title: Mucaaradka Israa'iil oo baaritaan ka dalbaday sheegashooyin ah in xafiiska Netanyahu uu faragaliyay doorashada
item.description: Xildhibaanno iyo hoggaamiyeyaal mucaarad ah oo Israa'iil ah ayaa Isniinta dalbaday baaritaan, kadib warbixin telefishin oo sheegtay in xubin ka tirsan shaqaalaha Ra'iisul Wasaare Benjamin Netanyahu ay booliiska siisay macluumaad ka dhan ah muwaadiniin Carab ah si loo saameeyo doorashadii bishii hore.

item.title: Shan dal oo Yurub ah oo si rasmi ah u shaaciyey qorshe ay magangalyo-doonka ugu dirayaan Rwanda
item.description: Jarmalka, Denmark, Austria, Giriigga iyo Netherlands ayaa Isniinta shaaciyey qorshe lagu doonayo in magangalyo-doonka codsigooda la diiday loo diro xarun laga dhisayo Rwanda, taas oo noqonaysa tii ugu horreysay ee noocaas ah oo ka baxsan Midowga Yurub.

item.title: Iceland oo u dallacday heerka B ee Nations League, Faroe Islands oo gaartay ciyaaraha isreebreebka
item.description: Xulka Iceland ayaa Isniinta 3-0 ku garaacay Luxembourg, waxayna si toos ah ugu dallacday heerka B ee UEFA Nations League, halka Faroe Islands ay 1-0 kaga adkaatay Moldova kana heshay kaalin ciyaaraha isreebreebka.

item.title: Somaliland oo sheegtay inay muddo kooban xirtay shan Mareykan ah oo ay ku eedeysay khatar amni
item.description: Hay'adda Sirdoonka Qaranka ee Somaliland (NIA) ayaa sheegtay inay muddo kooban xabsi ku haysay shan muwaadin oo Mareykan ah oo ay ku tilmaantay khatar ku ah amniga, kadibna ay ku wareejisay Safaaradda Mareykanka.

item.title: Horyaalka ACC oo ciqaabay Louisville iyo North Carolina kadib dagaal ka dhacay dhammaadka ciyaar
item.description: Horyaalka kubbadda cagta Mareykanka ee jaamacadaha ACC ayaa ganaax iyo canaan rasmi ah u diray jaamacadaha North Carolina iyo Louisville, isla markaana laba ciyaartoy u hakiyay badh ciyaar, kadib dagaal ka dhacay dhammaadka kulankii Sabtida.

item.title: Kameruun iyo Senegal oo u dhow inay u gudbaan Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2027
item.description: Senegal iyo Kameruun ayaa guulo dibadda ah ka gaaray ciyaaraha isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika (AFCON) 2027, waxayna u dhow yihiin inay u gudbaan finaalka oo lagu qaban doono Kenya, Tanzania iyo Uganda.

item.title: Thomas Frank oo si rasmi ah loogu magacaabay tababaraha cusub ee Crystal Palace
item.description: Crystal Palace ayaa Isniinta xaqiijisay in tababaraha reer Denmark Thomas Frank uu la saxiixday heshiis 2 sano iyo badh ah, isagoo bedelaya Pierre Sage oo toddobaadkii hore xilka laga qaaday.

item.title: Wasaaradda Warfaafinta oo kala noqotay ruqsadda Radio Geed Fadhi
item.description: Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa go'aan ku kala noqotay ruqsadda warbaahineed iyo shahaadada diiwaangelinta Radio Geed Fadhi, laga bilaabo 14 November 2026.

item.title: Robert Pattinson oo loo magacaabay jilaaga cusub ee James Bond
item.description: Shirkadda Amazon MGM ayaa Isniinta ku dhawaaqday in jilaaga Ingiriiska ah Robert Pattinson uu noqon doono jilaaga 7-aad ee ciyaara doorka basaasaha caanka ah James Bond, isagoo bedelaya Daniel Craig.

item.title: Hoggaamiyeyaasha Kaatooligga oo ka digay in Koonfur Suudaan lagu qasbo doorasho aan shuruudaheedu dhammeystirnayn
item.description: Shirka Hoggaamiyeyaasha Kaniisadda Kaatooligga ee Suudaan iyo Koonfur Suudaan ayaa ka digay in dalka lagu qasbo doorasho aan shuruudaheedu dhammeystirnayn ama lagu sii hayo xilli kala guur ah oo aan dhammaad lahayn, waxayna ugu baaqeen dhinacyada wadahadal dhab ah.

item.title: Kompany oo dib ugu laabtay tababarka Bayern, Alphonso Davies oo dhaawac muruq ah la dhacay
item.description: Tababaraha Bayern Munich Vincent Kompany ayaa Isniinta markii ugu horreysay muddo ka badan 3 toddobaad hoggaamiyay tababarka kooxda, kadib xanuun qoorgooye (meningitis) oo isbitaal la seexiyay, halka kooxdu ay xaqiijisay in Alphonso Davies uu dhaawac muruq ah la dhacay.

item.title: Caawiyayaasha Pochettino oo goor hore xerada Mareykanka uga ambabaxay Manchester United
item.description: Saddex ka mid ah caawiyayaasha Mauricio Pochettino ayaa ka tagay xerada xulka Mareykanka, waxayna u ambabaxeen Manchester si ay shaqada uga bilaabaan Manchester United ka hor kulanka Liverpool, sida ay werisay The Athletic.

item.title: Sacuudiga oo xilka ka qaaday taliyaha isbahaysiga Yemen, iyadoo Xuuthiyiintu u soo dhowaanayaan Cadan
item.description: Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, xilka ka qaaday taliyaha isbahaysiga ay hoggaamiso ee la dagaallamaya Xuuthiyiinta Yemen, xilli kooxdu ay u soo dhowaanayso magaalada Cadan, sida ay werisay France 24 iyadoo xigatay warbaahinta dowladda Sacuudiga.

item.title: Carlos Alcaraz oo 6-2, 6-2 kaga adkaaday Frances Tiafoe kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee ATP Finals
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, Frances Tiafoe kaga adkaaday 6-2, 6-2 saacad iyo sagaal daqiiqo gudahood, kulankiisii furitaanka ee ATP Finals, inkastoo uu jilibka midig ku xirnaa faashad, sida ay wariyeen AS iyo kicker.

item.title: Iran oo sheegtay inaysan u oggolaan doonin kormeerayaasha IAEA xarumaha nukliyeerka ilaa dagaalku dhammaado
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, sheegtay inay hor istaagi doonto in kormeerayaasha Hay'adda Tamarta Atomiga ee Caalamka (IAEA) ay booqdaan xarumaheeda nukliyeerka ee waxyeelloobay, ilaa shuruudaha ay dhigtay ee dhammaadka dagaalka Mareykanku ka fuliyo.

item.title: SoDMA oo shirka COP31 ka sheegtay in isbeddelka cimiladu uu sii huriyo barakaca Soomaaliya
item.description: Guddoomiyaha Hay'adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka Soomaaliyeed (SoDMA), Maxamuud Macallin Cabdulle, ayaa doodda IGAD ee shirka cimilada COP31 ku baaqay maalgelin joogto ah iyo iskaashi gobol iyo caalami si bulshooyinka Soomaaliyeed loogu xoojiyo u adkeysiga abaaraha iyo fatahaadaha.

item.title: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamsa oo Muqdisho ka furay shirweynaha 3-aad ee qaran ee dabagalka iyo qiimeynta
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, Muqdisho ka furay Shirweynaha Saddexaad ee Qaranka ee Dabagalka iyo Qiimeynta (SNMEC 2026), isagoo ku baaqay in waxqabadka dowladda lagu cabbiro natiijooyin la taaban karo oo xog lagu caddeyn karo.

item.title: Safiirka Shiinaha: Shiinaha iyo Jabuuti waxay diidan yihiin aqoonsiga Somaliland
item.description: Safiirka Shiinaha u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Wang Yu, ayaa Isniintii, 16 November 2026, sheegay in Shiinaha iyo Jabuuti ay taageerayaan midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya, ayna ka soo horjeedaan dadaallada Somaliland ee aqoonsiga diblomaasiyadeed, sida ay werisay Hiiraan Online.

item.title: Aragti: Xil qaran iyo dhalasho labaad – yaa difaacaya sharafta Soomaaliya?
item.description: Qormadan aragtida ah waxay su’aal ka keenaysaa jawaabta Wasiiru Dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, oo loo fasiran karo inuu ka gaabsaday inuu dhaliilo madaxweynaha Mareykanka, iyo masuuliyadda uu xilka qaran ku leeyahay difaaca karaamada shacabka.

item.title: Vinícius Júnior oo qiray in xiisihii Arsenal ee xagaagii uu saameeyay qaabka ciyaartiisa
item.description: Weeraryahanka Real Madrid, Vinícius Júnior, ayaa sheegay in warar kala iibsiga ee xagaagii, oo ay ugu weyneyd xiisaha Arsenal, ay maskaxdiisa ku jahwareeriyeen, taasoo qeyb ka ah bilowga liita ee xilli ciyaareedkan, sida ay wariyeen The Athletic iyo Capital FM.

item.title: Madaxweynaha xiriirka Faransiiska, Philippe Diallo, oo loo tixgelinayo inuu la tartamo Infantino
item.description: Madaxweynaha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Faransiiska, Philippe Diallo, ayaa soo baxay inuu noqon karo musharax ka soo horjeeda Gianni Infantino doorashada madaxtinimada FIFA ee March, sida ay wariyeen The Athletic iyo RMC Sport.
